title: 🌙 नीलू की टॉर्च बुझी, कहानी का आख़िरी पन्ना अब कैसे पढ़ेगी वह? #kahani #bedtimestories
title_alts: 🌙 नीलू ने अँधेरे में कहानी खोली, पर आख़िरी पन्ना कैसे पढ़ेगी? #kahani #bedtimestories
🌙 क्या नीलू बिना टॉर्च अपनी कहानी का आख़िरी पन्ना पढ़ पाएगी? #kahani #bedtimestories
refrain: एक पन्ना, एक पन्ना, और एक
description_hook: नीलू की टॉर्च ठीक आख़िरी पन्ने पर बुझ गई, और कमरे में एक भी बत्ती बाकी नहीं थी। उसने बिना किसी को जगाए रोशनी ढूँढ ली।

characters.name: नीलू
characters.description: six-year-old girl, short bobbed black hair, red pyjamas printed with white stars, a chipped front tooth

scenes.narration: अंत जानना था नीलू को, वरना सपना अधूरा। वह रजाई में घुसी, कहानी खोली और बोली, एक पन्ना, एक पन्ना, और एक।
scenes.caption: Nilu needed the ending tonight. She opened the book: one page, one page, one more.
scenes.image_brief: Nilu, a six-year-old girl with short bobbed black hair and red star-print pyjamas, sits cross-legged under a thick quilt on a low wooden bed, an open picture book on her knees and a small yellow torch beside her, in a dim bedroom with one window showing the night sky.

scenes.narration: टॉर्च जलाकर उसने पढ़ा। रोशनी काँपी, अक्षर नाचे। फिर टॉर्च ने आख़िरी बार टिमटिमाया।
scenes.caption: She read by torchlight. The beam shook, the letters danced. Then the torch blinked out.
scenes.image_brief: Nilu in red star-print pyjamas holds the small yellow torch over her open picture book, its weak beam wobbling across the page, quilt bunched around her shoulders, the rest of the bedroom dark.

scenes.narration: छोटे भाई ने कुहनी मारी, बत्ती बंद, मुझे नींद चाहिए। दरवाज़ा भिड़ गया। नीलू फुसफुसाई, मेरे साथ बोलो, एक पन्ना, एक पन्ना, और एक।
scenes.caption: Her little brother elbowed her: lights off. The door shut. Say it with her.
scenes.image_brief: Nilu's younger brother, a four-year-old boy in blue pyjamas, pushes his elbow into Nilu's arm on the same bed while Nilu hugs her closed picture book; the bedroom door is shut and the only light is pale night sky through the window.

scenes.narration: नीलू ने माँ के डिब्बे से छोटा शीशा निकाला। उसे खिड़की पर टेढ़ा टिकाया। चाँद की लकीर सीधी किताब पर गिरी।
scenes.caption: Nilu took a little mirror, tilted it on the sill, and bent moonlight onto the book.
scenes.image_brief: Nilu kneels at the bedroom window holding a small round mirror propped at a slant on the stone sill; a narrow band of moonlight bounces from the mirror onto her open picture book on the floor, her brother asleep on the bed behind her.

scenes.narration: पन्ने चाँदी जैसे चमके। नीलू ने गिनती की। तुम भी गिनो, तीन पन्ने बचे हैं!
scenes.caption: The pages shone like silver. Count along with her: three pages left!
scenes.image_brief: Nilu lies on her stomach on the bedroom floor inside the pale strip of bounced moonlight, picture book open in front of her, three pages pinched between her fingers, her face calm and happy.

scenes.narration: आख़िरी पन्ना पलटते हुए नीलू मुस्कुराई। एक पन्ना, एक पन्ना, और एक।
scenes.caption: Turning the last page, Nilu smiled. One page, one page, one more.
scenes.image_brief: Nilu turning the final page of the picture book in the moonlight strip on the bedroom floor, smiling wide with her chipped front tooth showing, the small mirror still propped on the sill behind her.

title: 🐾 दीपू की नींद उड़ गई, पड़ोस का पिल्ला रात भर क्यों रोता रहा? #kahani #bedtimestories
title_alts: 🐾 दीपू ने तकिए में मुँह छिपाया, फिर भी पिल्ला रोता रहा, अब क्या? #kahani #bedtimestories
🐾 क्या दीपू कुत्तों के शोर के बीच अपनी नींद वापस पा सकेगा? #kahani #bedtimestories
refrain: लोरी एक, लोरी दो, लोरी तीन
description_hook: पड़ोस का पिल्ला पूरी रात रोता रहा और दीपू की नींद उड़ गई। चिल्लाने से कुछ नहीं हुआ, तो दीपू ने एक अलग सवाल पूछा।

characters.name: दीपू
characters.description: seven-year-old boy, cropped hair, green sleeveless vest and striped shorts, a red thread tied on his wrist

scenes.narration: नींद चाहिए थी दीपू को, पर पड़ोस का पिल्ला रोता रहा। उसने तकिए में मुँह छिपाकर कहा, लोरी एक, लोरी दो, लोरी तीन।
scenes.caption: Deepu wanted sleep, but next door's puppy kept crying. Lullaby one, two, three.
scenes.image_brief: Deepu, a seven-year-old boy with cropped hair in a green sleeveless vest, lies on a string cot on a moonlit courtyard veranda with his face half buried in a flat pillow; a small brown puppy whines at the iron gate across the courtyard.

scenes.narration: दीपू ने कहा, चुप! पिल्ला और ज़ोर से रोया।
scenes.caption: Quiet, said Deepu. The puppy only cried louder.
scenes.image_brief: Deepu sitting up on the string cot in the moonlit courtyard, one arm stretched toward the gate and his mouth open shouting; the small brown puppy at the iron gate with its head tipped back, howling.

scenes.narration: उसने दो कंबल सिर पर ओढ़े। आवाज़ फिर भी भीतर आई।
scenes.caption: He piled two blankets over his head. The crying still got through.
scenes.image_brief: Deepu on the string cot in the moonlit courtyard with two thick blankets heaped over his head, only his feet showing, the iron gate and the whining brown puppy behind him.

scenes.narration: फिर दूसरा कुत्ता भौंका, तीसरा भी। बहन जाग गई और रोने लगी। दीपू फुसफुसाया, मेरे साथ गिनो, लोरी एक, लोरी दो, लोरी तीन।
scenes.caption: A second dog barked, then a third. His sister woke crying. Count with Deepu.
scenes.image_brief: Two more street dogs barking outside the iron gate of the moonlit courtyard while Deepu stands on the veranda; in the doorway behind him a baby girl sits up on a mat crying, a kerosene lamp glowing beside her.

scenes.narration: दीपू गेट तक गया। पिल्ला अकेला था, टोकरी खाली। उसने दादी से पूछा, टोकरी खिड़की के नीचे रख दूँ?
scenes.caption: Deepu went to the gate. The puppy was alone. Could its basket come to my window?
scenes.image_brief: Deepu standing at the iron gate in the moonlit courtyard pointing toward his own window, talking to an old woman in a grey shawl who holds an empty round cane basket; the small brown puppy presses against his ankles.

scenes.narration: पिल्ला तकिए के पास सो गया। तुम भी थपकी दो, एक, दो, तीन।
scenes.caption: The puppy fell asleep beside the pillow. Pat along with him: one, two, three.
scenes.image_brief: The small brown puppy curled asleep in its cane basket set right under Deepu's window on the veranda, Deepu's hand reaching down from the string cot to pat it, moonlight across the courtyard.

scenes.narration: दीपू की आँखें भारी हुईं, और वह हँसा। लोरी एक, लोरी दो, लोरी तीन।
scenes.caption: Deepu's eyes grew heavy and he laughed. Lullaby one, lullaby two, lullaby three.
scenes.image_brief: Deepu asleep on the string cot on the moonlit veranda with one arm hanging down toward the cane basket where the brown puppy sleeps, the courtyard quiet and empty behind them.

title: 🌕 अमायरा का चाँद बार बार टंकी के पीछे खिसक जाता है, अब क्या? #kahani #bedtimestories
title_alts: 🌕 क्या अमायरा अपने बिस्तर के ठीक ऊपर पूरा चाँद रोक पाएगी? #kahani #bedtimestories
🌕 अमायरा ने चारपाई तीन बार सरकाई, पर चाँद पकड़ में क्यों नहीं? #kahani #bedtimestories
refrain: चाँद इधर, चाँद उधर, चाँद मेरा
description_hook: अमायरा चाँद को अपने बिस्तर के ऊपर रोकना चाहती थी, पर चाँद हर बार टंकी के पीछे खिसक जाता। छत पर उसने एक तरकीब निकाली।

characters.name: अमायरा
characters.description: five-year-old girl, two high plaits tied with yellow ribbons, orange nightdress, a silver anklet on one foot

scenes.narration: छत पर अमायरा को चाँद बिस्तर के ऊपर चाहिए था। उसने गाया, चाँद इधर, चाँद उधर, चाँद मेरा।
scenes.caption: On the terrace, Amayra wanted the moon right above her bed. She sang to it.
scenes.image_brief: Amayra, a five-year-old girl with two high plaits tied with yellow ribbons and an orange nightdress, stands on a flat open terrace at night beside a string cot with a folded quilt, arms lifted toward a big low moon, a black water tank at one corner of the terrace.

scenes.narration: अमायरा ने चारपाई तीन बार सरकाई। चाँद हर बार टंकी के पीछे खिसक गया।
scenes.caption: Amayra shifted the cot three times. Each time the moon slid behind the tank.
scenes.image_brief: Amayra dragging the string cot across the terrace floor with both hands, her silver anklet showing, while the moon sits half hidden behind the black water tank in the corner.

scenes.narration: उसने हाथ बढ़ाकर चाँद पकड़ा। मुट्ठी खाली रही।
scenes.caption: She stretched up and grabbed at the moon. Her fist stayed empty.
scenes.image_brief: Amayra standing on the folded quilt on the cot, one arm stretched high with fingers closing on empty air, the moon far behind her hand, the terrace floor and water tank below.

scenes.narration: अमायरा की चारपाई का पैर अलगनी में फँसा। गीले कपड़े धूल में गिरे। मेरे साथ गाओ, चाँद इधर, चाँद उधर, चाँद मेरा।
scenes.caption: The cot leg caught the washing line. Wet clothes fell in the dust. Sing with her.
scenes.image_brief: The wooden leg of the string cot hooked into a sagging washing line on the terrace, two wet cloths lying crumpled in the dust beside it, Amayra looking down at them with her hands on her cheeks, moon hidden behind the water tank.

scenes.narration: अमायरा ने पीछा छोड़ा। थाली में पानी भरकर लौटी। चाँद उसमें उतर आया।
scenes.caption: Amayra gave up the chase. She came back with a dish of water. The moon came down.
scenes.image_brief: Amayra kneeling on the terrace holding a wide steel dish filled to the brim with water, the full moon reflected clearly inside the dish, her face lit by that reflection.

scenes.narration: चाँद अमायरा की बगल में तैर रहा था। तुम भी फूँक मारो, वह हिलेगा!
scenes.caption: Now the moon floated right beside Amayra. Blow on the water and it wobbles!
scenes.image_brief: Amayra lying on the string cot under her quilt with the steel dish of water set on the cot beside her pillow, the moon's reflection rippling in the dish, her lips pursed to blow at it.

scenes.narration: अमायरा मुस्कुराकर सो गई, पानी का चाँद जागता रहा। चाँद इधर, चाँद उधर, चाँद मेरा।
scenes.caption: Amayra smiled and slept; the water's moon stayed awake. Moon here, moon there, moon mine.
scenes.image_brief: Amayra asleep on the string cot on the terrace with one hand resting against the steel dish, the moon's reflection still bright in the water, the dark water tank behind them.

title: ⛵ गुड्डू की कागज़ की नाव सँकरी नाली में फँसी, पार कैसे जाएगी? #kahani #bedtimestories
title_alts: ⛵ क्या गुड्डू की कागज़ की नाव शाम ढलने से पहले पार पहुँचेगी? #kahani #bedtimestories
⛵ गुड्डू ने नाव को दो बार धक्का दिया, फिर भी हवा उलटी क्यों? #kahani #bedtimestories
description_hook: गुड्डू की कागज़ की नाव को शाम ढलने से पहले दूसरे किनारे पहुँचना था, पर सँकरी नाली में एक बड़ी नाव अड़ गई।

characters.name: गुड्डू
characters.description: eight-year-old boy, thick curly hair, mustard shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbow, muddy knees

scenes.narration: शाम ढलने से पहले गुड्डू की नाव को पार पहुँचना था। उसने बोला, एक धक्का, दो धक्का, पार!
scenes.caption: Before dusk, Guddu's boat had to reach the far bank. One push, two pushes, across!
scenes.image_brief: Guddu, an eight-year-old boy with thick curly hair, a mustard shirt rolled to the elbows and muddy knees, crouches at the edge of a village pond setting a small folded paper boat on the water, reeds along the far bank, low orange evening sun.

scenes.narration: नाव दो हाथ चली, फिर लौट आई। हवा उलटी थी।
scenes.caption: The boat sailed two arm-lengths, then drifted back. The wind was against it.
scenes.image_brief: The small paper boat spinning back toward Guddu's feet on the pond water, Guddu crouched at the muddy edge with both hands on his knees watching it, ripples spreading around the boat.

scenes.narration: गुड्डू ने कंकड़ फेंका। नाव किनारे से चिपकी रही।
scenes.caption: Guddu threw a pebble to make waves. The boat stuck by the bank.
scenes.image_brief: Guddu standing and tossing a small pebble into the village pond, rings of water spreading out, his paper boat still pressed against the muddy bank among a few floating leaves.

scenes.narration: एक बड़ा लड़का बड़ी नाव लेकर आया। दोनों नावें सँकरी नाली में फँस गईं।
scenes.caption: A bigger boy arrived with a bigger boat. Both boats jammed in the narrow channel.
scenes.image_brief: A taller boy in a blue shirt lowering a large paper boat into the same narrow water channel between the reeds where Guddu's small paper boat is already wedged, Guddu watching from the muddy pond edge.

scenes.narration: गुड्डू की नाव भीगने लगी। मेरे साथ बोलो, एक धक्का, दो धक्का, पार!
scenes.caption: Guddu's boat was going soggy. Say it with him: one push, two pushes, across!
scenes.image_brief: Guddu's small paper boat tilting in the narrow water channel with its paper walls darkening as they soak, the bigger boat pressing behind it, Guddu's muddy hands hovering just above the water.

scenes.narration: गुड्डू ने सौदा किया, तुम्हारी नाव आगे, मेरी पीछे। घास की लंबी पत्ती से दोनों नावें बाँध दीं।
scenes.caption: Guddu made a deal: your boat in front, mine behind. He tied them with a grass blade.
scenes.image_brief: Guddu kneeling beside the taller boy in the blue shirt at the pond edge, knotting a long blade of grass between the big paper boat and his own small paper boat so they sit one behind the other in the channel.

scenes.narration: बड़ी नाव खींचती गई, छोटी पीछे नाचती। तुम भी हाथ हिलाकर हवा दो!
scenes.caption: The big boat pulled, the little one danced behind. Fan the wind with your hand!
scenes.image_brief: The big paper boat moving across the open pond water with Guddu's small paper boat trailing behind it on a grass tether, both boys waving their hands above the water to push air, evening light on the pond.

scenes.narration: दोनों नावें पार लगीं और गुड्डू खिलखिलाया। एक धक्का, दो धक्का, पार!
scenes.caption: Both boats touched the far bank and Guddu burst out laughing. One push, two, across!
scenes.image_brief: Both paper boats nudged against the reeds on the far bank of the village pond, Guddu standing knee-deep at the near edge laughing with his arms up, the taller boy in the blue shirt clapping beside him.
